description: Blast L2 native yield from the chain itself: for the rebasing USDB (stablecoin yield) and WETH (ETH staking yield) predeploy contracts, total supply and share price — the cumulative native-yield multiplier since launch (e.g. 1.126 = 12.6% earned) — plus latest/safe/finalized blocks, finality lag, gas price and block time. Blast Gold / DApp points are allocated off-chain by Blast and have no public API, so they are not reported. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_blast_gold_points
title: Crypto Blast Gold Points
